title: Saudi deposits: savings pass current accounts
sources: SAMA September 2026 data, via Asharq Al-Awsat (18 Nov 2026) and Argaam

slides.title: Savings passed current accounts.
slides.sub: What it means for bank margins, in 6 slides.

slides.label: Time and savings deposits
slides.note: Demand deposits: SAR 1.405tn. Argaam reports it's the first time since 2008.

slides.label: Total bank deposits, up 4.8% on a year ago
slides.note: The pool grew. The mix moved toward deposits that pay interest.

slides.title: Funding cost
points: Time deposits pay interest. Current accounts mostly don't. The same deposit base costs banks more to fund.
Asharq Al-Awsat notes a higher share doesn't have to lift funding costs one for one. Q4 results will show how much reached margins.

slides.text: Net interest margins in the Q4 bank results.
